fusions.name: Tenderising Blow
fusions.desc: A crushing blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. You heal for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pounded Flat
fusions.desc: Brings your full weight down, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. You restore 14 health.

fusions.name: Levelled Ground
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds. You restore 12 health when you use it.

fusions.name: Softened Up
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
